svg.aria-label: Illustration of breadth-first search on the hallway ring: a wavefront expands from the NPC in both directions, props block tiles, and the shortest path is highlighted
svg.text: BFS WAVEFRONT ON THE HALLWAY RING
REAL BFS ON AN ILLUSTRATIVE MAP
Every walkable tile is a node and its four neighbours
BFS spreads outwards one ring of tiles at a time, so the
first time it reaches the goal is the fewest-step route.
Props block tiles. The hallway is a ring, so a blocked
route sends the NPC round the other way.
A* later adds a distance guess to search fewer tiles.
NPCs currently walk fixed waypoint loops. BFS and A* are next.
